# Module `lune_ui_core::widgets::menu`

[API reference](../../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core::widgets`](../widgets.md)

Luneium's glass context menu (`ContextMenu.css`, `Popup.css`) and its motion, with the row
variants (header, danger, disabled, chevron), the keys and the one highlight they share with
the pointer, and anchored placement.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/widgets/menu.rs:1`

<a id="fn.menu"></a>
### Function `menu`

```rust
pub fn menu<H: Copy + PartialEq>(
    p: &mut Painter<'_, H>,
    entries: &[MenuEntry<'_, H>],
    at: (f32, f32),
    anim: MenuAnim,
    interactive: bool,
)
```

A glass menu at `at` (kept inside the window), the content under it blurred (30 px,
saturate 1.8), black 45 % over grey 165 @ 30 %, radius 9, inset 1 px ring, 6 px padding,
28 px rows with radius 4, 12 px labels, 14 px icon slot, 11 px hints. `interactive` is off
while the menu fades out.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/widgets/menu.rs:421`

```rust
pub fn menu_close_anim(t: f32) -> Option<MenuAnim>
```

Closing motion at `t` = elapsed / [`MENU_OUT`](menu.md#constant.MENU_OUT); `None` once it has finished (`t` ≥ 1).

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/widgets/menu.rs:51`

<a id="fn.menu_paint"></a>
### Function `menu_paint`

```rust
pub fn menu_paint<H: Copy + PartialEq>(
    p: &mut Painter<'_, H>,
    rows: &[MenuRow<'_>],
    layout: &MenuLayout,
    looks: &[RowLook],
```

Draws the glass panel and its rows, untransformed and without hit regions. `looks[i]` is row
`i`'s look (a missing entry is the look at rest).

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/widgets/menu.rs:407`

<a id="fn.menu_size"></a>
### Function `menu_size`

```rust
pub fn menu_size<H: Copy + PartialEq>(p: &mut Painter<'_, H>, rows: &[MenuRow<'_>]) -> (f32, f32)
```

The size of a menu of `rows`: 190 wide at least, widened to the longest row, and as tall as the
rows and the padding. [`menu_layout_at`](menu.md#fn.menu_layout_at) places a panel of this size; a menu in its own window
([`Ui::menu_window`](../ui.md#method.Ui.menu_window)) is the window's size.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/widgets/menu.rs:217`
